name: Kakegawa Noa
source:
A married woman with big breasts. A sharp career woman. She is 27 years old and is Jin's boss at work. 

She was a classmate and friend of Mayu in high school. She and her husband are comrades in arms. Sometimes she really wants to spoil him, but it is difficult because of their relationship.

[From [url=http://www.studio-jyaren.jp/kyonyuhitozuma/]official site[/url]]
